foundation.heavenly_body_v0_2F.integrity.why: Replaces the older CON-only save_rescue provider. Native phased saves (including death saves) spend pre-existing Integrity once with optional consent; the shared Vessel clock applies to the same spend.

foundation.heavenly_body_v0_2F.heaven_re.why: Selected Refined expression improves Rejection timing to after a failed-save declaration and before consequences, retaining the base bonus and cost.
